note: Phase 18 (BPMN e2e retirement, plan §5.3/§21.3) retargeted tests/e2e/lite-mandatory-ai-security.spec.ts from the deleted bpmn-js Lite shell (sidebar AiPanelLite) to the ARIS shell (ArisGenerationPanel + the shared Settings — AI keys dialog, the same Phase-1 credential infrastructure tests/e2e/lite-providers.spec.ts already retargeted). All 10 requirement ids retain genuine coverage, but two are narrowed with a disclosed gap rather than fully satisfied: AI-03's 'relevance' clause and three of AI-07's five cancellation paths (interview, workspace-replacement, DOCX-replacement) have no reachable ARIS mechanism — see the per-requirement notes below for the specific, source-grounded reason each is unreachable. Two tests were deleted outright (workspace-replacement cancellation — the shared reliability-fsa.ts fixture's fake directory handle throws DataCloneError in ArisApp.tsx's handleOpenFolder before any second workspace can be opened, independently corroborated by the sibling mandatory-reliability-evidence.json retarget; DOCX-replacement cancellation — ArisGenerationPanel.pickDocx tracks no request identity, so a late first result silently overwrites a second pick's already-displayed state, verified live).
